reference_sql:
WITH prod AS (
  -- one row per product sold by the webshop in the period
  SELECT product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY product_id
), ranked AS (
  -- one row per product sold by the webshop in the period
  SELECT product_id, revenue_eur,
    SUM(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_eur DESC, product_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_eur,
    SUM(revenue_eur) OVER () AS total_eur
  FROM prod
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM ranked
WHERE running_eur - revenue_eur < 0.6 * total_eur

WITH prod AS (
  -- one row per product sold by the webshop in the period
  SELECT product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM prod p
WHERE (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.revenue_eur), 0) FROM prod q
       WHERE q.revenue_eur > p.revenue_eur OR (q.revenue_eur = p.revenue_eur AND q.product_id < p.product_id))
      < 0.6 * (SELECT SUM(revenue_eur) FROM prod)
